quarterly_data.quarter: Zhongtian Technology annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2025 annual report: Zhongtian joined the core suppliers of data-center cabling high-speed interconnect for leading internet companies such as Alibaba and Tencent, with optical modules and MPO connectors in batch supply; its self-developed 10-Gigabit multimode fiber is used at scale in Alibaba Cloud's global data centers. The company says revenue from intelligent-computing-center business rose substantially and its high-speed optical modules reached scale shipments; its interconnect offering includes bend-insensitive fiber, 224G copper cable, 800G optical modules and ultra-high-fiber-count cable, and its high-fiber-count flexible ribbon cable entered the North American computing market.

quarterly_data.quarter: Zhongtian Technology annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2025 annual report: hollow-core fiber reached scale production and was delivered to several commercial pilot projects; multi-core fiber is in stable volume production with single-fiber capacity up 7 times. Zhongtian delivered hollow-core cable for Sichuan Telecom's quantum communication network and with China Telecom and the University of Electronic Science and Technology of China built what it calls the world's first long-distance low-loss hollow-core quantum communication network; with Huawei it achieved what it calls China's first scale application of O-band anti-resonant hollow-core fiber for intra-data-center connections; its hollow-core fiber supported a UAE telecom operator's first technical trial in the Middle East.

quarterly_data.quarter: Zhongtian Technology annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2025 annual report: won first place in both China Mobile's 2025 ordinary cable and butterfly drop-cable centralized procurements; optical cable won large operator projects in several European and Latin American countries and optical-electrical composite cable entered an Oceania operator's supply chain; high-performance G.654.E fiber OPGW won national UHV projects including Shaanbei-Anhui, Gansu-Zhejiang and Datong-Tianjin South. Its high-efficiency transformers and power modules serve projects including the Huawei Xining data center and the China Telecom Guizhou data center.

quarterly_data.quarter: Zhongtian Technology annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Company (2026 business plan in the 2025 annual report): it will develop C+L-band hollow-core fiber and O-band hollow-core fiber jumpers; for AI computing it will build high-efficiency cooling, intelligent power supply and HVDC - developing liquid-cooling control and drive components in-house and launching data-center high-efficiency power routers and 800V DC distribution cabinets; facing AI-infrastructure demand it will optimise domestic and overseas plants for fiber and cable, optical modules and liquid-cooling systems and evaluate new capacity in Southeast Asia, the Middle East and Africa.
